title: blepharitheca puberula
intro: Blepharitheca puberula, commonly known as the sticky snail shell or snail flower, is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Blepharitheca puberula include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins have been identified in the plant, contributing to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
